answer.summary: Ashes of the Empire is one survivors' camp laid out along a street among imperial ruins: a collapsed great hall at the centre, four timber-and-cloth shelters, a repaired watchtower on high ground, a scavengers' forge, a communal hearth, a garden and storehouse, a toppled emperor's monument and a barricaded gatehouse at the edge. It is built on the land as it is, with no sculpting, near the founding stone.
